usedFor: HubSpot holds your support tickets, and Productlane records each one as a note through “Create Note”.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Created or Updated” in HubSpot, then “Create Note” in Productlane
bestTemplate.why: Each ticket reaches Productlane as a note, so product sees what customers are reporting.

watchOut: “Ticket Created or Updated” also fires on edits, so one ticket can create more than one note.
